module.title: Online store
module.description: Website CMS — pages, catalog, and storefront content

homepage.title: Homepage
homepage.description: Page builder for homepage sections — hero, promotional blocks, featured collections, and layout.
homepage.empty: No sections yet. Add a section from the palette.
homepage.loadError: Could not load the homepage. Try again.
homepage.removeConfirmDescription: Remove "{name}" from the homepage? This cannot be undone until you reload.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.description: Announcement bar at the top of the storefront.

announcement.title: Announcement bar
announcement.description: A strip above the store header with multiple messages that scroll continuously.
announcement.itemsHint: Add separate messages; only enabled ones appear in the scrolling bar.
announcement.empty: No messages yet. Add a message for the bar.
announcement.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Free shipping on orders over YER 200
announcement.messagePlaceholderAr: e.g. Free shipping on orders over YER 200
announcement.messagePlaceholderEn: e.g. Free shipping on orders over YER 200
announcement.hrefHint: Leave empty if the message is text-only with no link.
announcement.dismissibleHint: Shows a close button; dismissal lasts for the browser session.
announcement.scrollingHint: When off, messages stay static with no motion.
announcement.speedMsHint: Duration of one full scroll loop. Lower = faster. Range 3000–120000. Applies only when scrolling is on.
announcement.speedInSettings: Bar speed and dismiss options are managed in

banners.title: Hero carousel
banners.description: Manage the promotional slides at the top of the store homepage.
banners.empty: No slides yet. Add a slide with an image and description.
banners.loadError: Could not load the hero carousel.
banners.removeSlideDescription: This removes the slide from the carousel. Save to keep the change.
banners.previewEmpty: Add an enabled slide to see the preview.
banners.intervalMsHint: Time before moving to the next slide. Smaller = faster. Range 1000–30000.

storeSettings.title: Homepage sections
storeSettings.description: Homepage section titles, enable/disable, and display order.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Footer link groups and copyright owner.
footer.linkGroupsHint: What you configure here appears as-is in the storefront footer. Account links (login, wishlist, orders) stay in the header icons only.
footer.emptyLinks: No links in this group yet.

content.title: Content
content.description: Storefront pages and FAQ — one place for website content.

cmsPages.title: CMS pages
cmsPages.description: Edit store pages, FAQ, and legal content.
cmsPages.studioHint: Pick any page and edit its copy. Changes appear in the storefront after save — page structure stays the same.
cmsPages.groupStoreHint: About and contact pages for the storefront.
cmsPages.groupContentHint: FAQ lists managed as editable items.
cmsPages.editContentHint: Edit questions and answers, then save from the page header.
cmsPages.editDialogHint: Update the copy only — storefront routes stay unchanged.
cmsPages.catalogHint: Show or hide this page in the store only — no editable content here.
cmsPages.headline: Headline
cmsPages.statsHint: Numbers shown on the About page (e.g. products count or years of experience).
cmsPages.statsEmpty: No stats yet. Add an item to show it on the storefront.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Manage frequently asked questions on the storefront.
faq.removeItemDescription: This removes the question from the list. Save to keep the change.
faq.question: Question
faq.questionPlaceholder: e.g. How long does delivery take?

seo.title: SEO defaults
seo.description: Data search engines read when indexing storefront pages.
seo.formHint: Enter clear copy as you want it to appear in search results. Saved in store settings and emitted as meta tags automatically.
seo.homeTitleHint: Shows as the blue title in Google results (preferably under 60 characters).
seo.homeDescriptionHint: Short summary under the title in search results (preferably under 160 characters).
seo.productsTitleHint: Title for the products listing page in search engines.
seo.productsDescriptionHint: Description shown with the products page in search results.
seo.keywordsPlaceholder: e.g. makeup, skincare, Nadara, Yemen delivery
seo.keywordsHint: Separate keywords with commas. Stored as a list and included in the keywords meta tag.
seo.defaultOgImageHint: Image shown when the store link is shared on WhatsApp or social apps.
seo.previewHint: Approximate Google appearance — not a live search result.
seo.previewDescriptionEmpty: Page description will appear under the title.

settings.title: Website settings
settings.description: Branding, bars, contact, social channels, shipping, and search-engine data.
settings.studioHint: Update branding, contact, shipping, and SEO from one place. Save from the page header after editing.
settings.brandingHint: Store name, logo, and favicon as visitors see them.
settings.contactHint: Contact details and commercial registration shown in the store and footer.
settings.checkoutHint: Delivery cities, shipping fees, and payment methods on checkout.
settings.name: Store name
settings.logoHint: Upload a logo image or pick one from the library.

bars.announcementDescription: Scroll speed and dismiss options for the top store messages bar.
bars.speedMsHint: Full marquee loop duration. Smaller = faster. Range 3000–120000.
bars.dismissibleHint: Shows a close button; dismiss is remembered for the session.
bars.heroDescription: How fast slides advance on the homepage hero.
bars.heroIntervalMsHint: Time before moving to the next slide. Smaller = faster. Range 1000–30000.
bars.heroMissing: No hero carousel yet. Create it from the Hero carousel page.

settings.commercialRegistrationHint: Shown on the storefront footer copyright line.
settings.socialHint: Enable a channel and add its URL to show it in the storefront footer.
settings.citiesHint: Cities customers can select when placing an order. The default city is pre-selected at checkout.
settings.citiesEmptyHint: Add at least one city so customers can choose a delivery city when ordering.
